back: Information that you will not have at prediction time enters training or features, so test scores look better than real results.

front: Why is a random split wrong for time series?
back: Training rows come from after the test rows. The model interpolates and neighbouring days look alike, so scores are too good.
Fit on the training set only, then apply the same numbers to the test set.
Random split, full-data statistics, future covariates, rolling features without a shift.

front: What is a gap (embargo) between train and test?
back: A few skipped steps at the cutoff so that overlapping features or labels do not reach across it.

front: How long should the test window be?
back: At least the forecast horizon, and better several windows, so one lucky period does not decide.
